manifest.name: dsh-tcp-forward
manifest.description: TCP forwarding for DeepSeek Harness Web

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: tcp-forward
      name: dsh-tcp-forward
      config:
        port: !!js Number(process.env.DSH_TCP_FORWARD_PORT ?? 3081)

- id: connection
  inject: [webRuntime, tcpForward]
  config:
    trustedHosts: !!js [...ctx.webRuntime.trustedHosts, ...ctx.tcpForward.trustedHosts]

readme.text:
Exposes the DeepSeek Harness Web server to the local network through a transparent TCP forward on `0.0.0.0:3081` by default, and adds the LAN listener addresses to DSH `trustedHosts`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Ri0n72Y/dsh-tcp-forward
dsh web
```

Set `DSH_TCP_FORWARD_PORT` to use another port.
